entries.en: Thank you for using Avina. Have a pleasant day.
You may see keepers involved in various tasks throughout all levels of the Citadel. We ask that you do not interfere with them in any way.
The keepers are essential to the smooth operation of the Citadel. Obstructing their daily work will result in harsh penalties, including incarceration and rehabilitation.
Welcome to Presidium Tourism Terminal II. You are standing near the base of the Citadel Tower, one of the Presidium's most recognizable and important structures.
Housing both the Council Chambers and Citadel Control, the Tower is one of the most important buildings on the station.
Access to these areas is restricted to those with the appropriate clearance.
The keepers do not communicate with other species. It is assumed, however, that the Tower houses the Citadel's primary control systems.
Many of the station's systems, such as navigation and life support, function automatically. It is believed the keepers operate those systems from inside the Tower's inaccessible core.
The keepers also make frequent appearances in the Council Chamber itself, though they appear to be just passing through on their way to some other destination.
The business of the Council, which often has far-reaching effects on the galactic community, is conducted in a room at the apex of the Citadel Tower.
The Council Chambers themselves are truly a magnificent sight to behold, though few get to experience the view in person.
Typically, only the Councilors, ambassadors, and high-ranking officials, along with various support staff, are allowed access.
The average citizen must go through the proper channels if they wish an audience with the Council. This is usually arranged through their respective ambassadors.
I'd like to hear more about the Council Chambers.
What if someone has business with the Council?
I've been inside the Council Chambers.
I'm scheduled to have an audience with the Council.
I'd like to know more about the keepers.
Tell me about the Citadel Tower.
Any particular reason there are so many keepers in this area?
It's not open to the public?
I've seen it.
I've been asked to go there.
Log off.
Why here?
Council Chambers
For your convenience, this terminal is programmed with information on the Tower, the Relay Monument, and the keepers.
Keepers can be seen in all sections of the Citadel, but are typically found in and around the Tower.
Greetings, and welcome to the Presidium. My name is Avina, and I am pleased to be your virtual guide throughout this level of the Citadel space station.
Our records indicate this is your first time on the Citadel. A brief orientation session is customary. Please allow me to do my job.
I am a fully interactive virtual intelligence, programmed to provide spontaneous guidance at predetermined locations of interest throughout this level of the Citadel.
I may also be contacted through any of the Presidium VI terminals, should you require assistance.
You are standing at Presidium Tourism Terminal II, located at the base of the Citadel Tower, one of the most recognizable and important features of the Presidium.
I apologize if you found my service unsatisfactory. Please submit any complaints in writing to the Citadel Tourist and Visitor Board. Have a nice day.
So are you a person or a program?
What does that mean?
I don't need a guide.
Give me the tour.
I'll pass.
Are you real?
Virtual guide?
No, thanks.
Sounds interesting.
Citadel Control handles all incoming and outbound transit.
Every ship within two thousand kilometers of the Citadel is under the jurisdiction of Citadel Control.
At peak capacity, they are responsible for monitoring upwards of a thousand vessels.
What happens in Citadel Control?
Behind me is the spectacular Relay Monument, a scale model representation of a Prothean mass relay.
Discovered by the asari who first arrived at the Citadel, the Relay Monument is one of the station's most interesting and controversial features.
What is the meaning behind this striking piece of art? Is it a tribute to Prothean vanity, a reminder of their conquest of the galaxy through mass relay technology?
Or perhaps it is a symbol of unity, a Prothean acknowledgement that the relays would eventually lead other species here to the Citadel?
No one can say for sure, making the Relay Monument a favorite topic of discussion among academics and scholars.
Tell me more about the Relay Monument.
Relay Monument
Citadel Control.
Welcome to the Presidium. Allow me to be your guide.
Look at that bug thing over there. What's it doing?
Please do not disturb the keepers.
The officer has left, and this one is free to share the glory of the Enkindlers. This one offers its appreciation.
This one observes the wisdom of your words.
The Enkindlers would wish for their message to be spread to all sentient races!
This one hears wisdom. Perhaps enthusiasm has clouded judgment in this matter.
This one departs now, and will not intrude upon the Presidium again.
This one will continue to spread its message.
This one has little money, but it can offer this.
Now, finally,  this one can continue sharing the truth unimpeded.
Has the C-Sec officer been assuaged?
Do you desire to learn of the Enkindlers? Or has the honorable C-Sec officer enlisted assistance?
The words this unworthy one speaks are merely observations of the truth.
The C-Sec officer requests that this one purchase an evangelical permit to spread the truth of the Enkindlers.
Your people know them as the Protheans. They are the true creators of this one's people.
The Enkindlers raised the hanar from ignorance into consciousness by granting this one's people the gift of speech.
The truth of the Enkindlers is universal. This one humbly believes that the truth should not be suppressed.
Exacting payment as a means of imposing limits upon the truth is an abrogation of this one's religious freedom.
The C-Sec officer states that preaching in this place is forbidden, and preaching anywhere on the Citadel requires a permit.
This one humbly submits that it is not preaching to state the truth of the Enkindlers, and thus, no permit should be necessary.
This one would be most grateful for the assistance. Please let this one know if success is achieved.
This one's beliefs will not be suppressed. If others wish to try, they are welcome to do so.
The truth of the Enkindlers must be made known. They gave the hanar language and gave the universe the mass relays.
This one is too humble to suggest that the C-Sec officer is personally biased.
This one only wishes to spread the truth to any who will listen. There is no intent to cause trouble.
Finances are only a partial limitation. This one does not believe that one should pay in order to speak the truth.
However, this one also does not possess the 150 credits necessary to purchase the permit.
This is a most appreciated action. You are not of the hanar, but you wish to help spread the truth of the Enkindlers.
This one will not cause any further trouble for the C-Sec officer. This one offers its thanks.
This one desires no charity! It only desires to spread the truth of the Enkindlers!
This one does not wish to prejudice the listeners against the hanar!
This one will obey. It does not wish to prejudice other species against the hanar.
This is your opportunity to show people that the hanar aren't crazy xenophobes. Don't waste it.
I knew it. You're not just evangelizing, you're panhandling!
I don't care about your intent. You're making all hanar look like troublemaking zealots.
If you want people's respect, you have to follow the rules. Buy the permit, and stay out of here.
You hanar deserve what you get. You're either too snobbish or too stupid to follow simple rules!
Is this how the Enkindlers would want you to use this gift of consciousness?
If the Protheans wanted you to force your message on the unwilling, they'd have said so.
The Enkindlers wouldn't wish their message to be spread by breaking society's laws.
I'll be back.
I'll keep working on it.
Why is the C-Sec officer harassing you?
Are you allowed to preach here in the Presidium?
Who are the Enkindlers?
If that's all the C-Sec officer wants, why not just buy the permit?
So you're breaking the law by preaching without a permit right now?
Let me talk to the C-Sec officer. Perhaps I can explain the situation.
This is the Presidium, not a church! Evangelize somewhere else.
Is this really how you want to represent the Enkindlers?
The C-Sec officer is just doing his job. You're causing trouble.
What if I purchased the evangelical permit for you?
150 credits? This should cover you.
Make the most of this.
Having trouble?
What are you doing?
This isn't the way.
You're breaking the law.
Enkindlers
Purchase a permit
Legality of preaching
I'd like to help.
Let me see what I can do.
Could I buy your permit?
There's trouble anyway.
This is unworthy of you.
You do now.
Another money-grabber.
You're doing so anyway.
Then buy the permit.
You're worthless.
Not this way.
You insult their memory.
They wouldn't want this.
I see the hanar has left. Thank you.
You have already demonstrated your ability. I acknowledge it, and I will learn from your example.
Here. For your assistance in this matter.
Now, if you will excuse me, I should report to my superiors.
Any progress with that hanar?
I don't care what the something is, as long as it rids me of the hanar.
That hanar refuses to listen to reason! Why can't it act in an orderly and lawful manner?
The Presidium is a place of culture and respect! It should not be filled with zealots shouting their idiocy!
I should have known that a human wouldn't respect the laws of the Citadel.
Why should the jellies get special treatment? Every other species understands and obeys the laws!
How can I convince my superior that I deserve a promotion if I cannot convince this annoying jelly to leave?
I am not unreasonable. The hanar is free to spew its nonsense once it purchases an evangelical permit.
Forcing religious evangelicals to register for a permit weeds out undesirables. It keeps the area safe.
The Citadel is too important to become a battleground for a religious war.
No. Registered evangelicals must follow regulations. There are specific areas where preaching is legal.
Failure to follow the regulations results in the forfeiture of the license.
I could arrest the jelly, but my superior has requested that I find a solution that does not anger the hanar.
The hanar become... vocal when they feel that their religious beliefs are being suppressed.
I have argued with the stubborn jelly all afternoon. You are certainly welcome to try.
I didn't ask for your help, human. I can deal with this myself!
